karmaSource.label: Which subreddit karma to count
karmaSource.helpText: Karma the user earned in this subreddit only. Sitewide karma is never used.

removeBelow.label: Remove comments when subreddit karma is below
removeBelow.helpText: 0 means any negative karma. Must be 0 or lower.

banBelow.label: Ban users when subreddit karma is below
banBelow.helpText: Suggested: -10 for small subs, -25 for mid-size, -50 for very large. Must be 0 or lower.

banMessage.label: Message sent to the banned user
banMessage.helpText: Placeholders: {username}, {subreddit}, {karma}, {threshold}. Up to 1000 characters; anything longer is cut off.
banMessage.defaultValue: Hi u/{username}, your karma in r/{subreddit} has dropped to {karma}, which is below this community's limit of {threshold}. You have been banned automatically. If you think this is a mistake please contact the moderators of this subreddit.

exemptUsers.label: Usernames that are always exempt
exemptUsers.helpText: Comma-separated, without u/. Example: alice, bob
